entry.text: Career Commencement: Nov’15-March’19 with BNY Mellon Technologies Pvt Ltd, Pune as Lead Business Analyst in Financial
Management Domain
Key Result Areas
• Spearheading end-to-end solution for integrating the central bank with the vendor by creating a robust & dynamic system
to reconcile end of day data without any fail along with all the financial instruments
• Generating data files by creating a Workflow under the BNY proprietary tool and co -ordinate with multiple  stakeholders to
provide timely delivery & validation for every end-of-day data
• Used SQL on a day-to-day basis for the creation of data files and apply logic according to the business requirements
• Also involved briefly with project related to Post Trade Settlement process
• Actively engaging in Onboarding lifecycle of Capital Markets products  (such as Derivatives, Bonds etc)  systems from its
mapping stage to Production stage
• Generating BFS & other Project related documents such as BRD for critical release schedules
• Interfacing with key project stakeholders to ensure timely & high-quality release of component features
• Verifying traceability between business & functional requirements by reviewing test cases and supporting business testing
Highlights
• Successfully completed the ITIL Foundation Course in 2016
Recognized as iCBA (iNautix Certified Business Analyst), an internal certification for Business Analysis in 2015
• Played a key role in implementing 4 projects, all BNY Onshore locations for removing legacy processes & creating new
reconciliation consumer systems
